followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the Moyale non-exempt passenger restriction and operational enforcement context; this is not evidence that all cargo stopped. The commissioner describes restricted persons in both directions, including informal-entry controls. Goods, a driver and turnboy remain excepted subject to health screening. The wider county frontier and informal routes are not all located. Retain the 24–29 March 2020 onset interval and 29 March last confirmation, with reopening unknown. The later trenches confrontation does not supply a reopening or establish continuous closure beyond the accepted confirmation. A zero-day lower bound is not a same-day completed closure. Human disease control follows the explicit COVID explanation. Trenching and illegal-entry language do not independently justify adding smuggling or migration purposes. The Standard passage was freshly retrieved; the Star passage and PIDA table were newly reread from saved receipts. The Star URL date differs from its displayed 1 April date, which is retained. No independent-origin count is inferred from the three source entries. The approved approximate Moyale point exactly matches PIDA E19, 3.52678 / 39.05284. It locates the named crossing component, not the reported county frontier or trench line. Preserve the qualified scope and stop animation at the last confirmation.
